notes.title: Alright... Its finally time to tell you guys whats going on.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29353093/b9fdab51840f8cf32f15015daf73164ca2a845f3.png[/img]

[h1]No the project isn't dead.[/h1]

Its been around 2 years now and to be honest its been a very rocky experience. However things are FINALLY starting to fall into place now thanks to our success with our publishing en devours with Snow Daze and getting some new blood. 

Let's try to keep this as simple as possible. 

[list]
[*]Lasterk is no longer the lead CG artist on this project. This is primarily due to the fact that he has basically disappeared from the internet. His twitter and Patreon haven't been updated in almost over year and we have completely lost contact with him.

[*]Part of the reason the game has been delayed so many times is due to the fact that he has been rather slow. However this is not without good reason. Lasterk suffers from severe health issues and family problems that can keep him away for long periods of time. We have no ill will towards him and wish him well, however we were eventually put into a situation that we had to find another artist to take over.

[*]We weren't going to settle for a "lesser" artist as a replacement since we promised to deliver a quirky, yet high quality presentation. After sometime we eventually found [url=https://twitter.com/anime_flux?lang=en]Anime Flux![/url] We teamed him up with [url=https://www.deviantart.com/tai-xi-studio]Tai-Xi Studios[/url] in order speed things up and have Flux just focus on doing what he loves to do best. 

[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e2zq6ds.png[/img]

[list]
[*] MegaSweet is still on board. Actually he been one of the most dependable people on the team and we can always rely on him to get things done. Due to this sometime during the project we moved him up from just a Chibi artist and decided to do something fun. WMNAD will have chibi h scenes and some of them or not only ANIMATED, but also interactive. 
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zal3Ozg.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We know this may be "unusual" for some, but we at Critical Bliss like pushing new ideas. Demon's will have around 20+ h scenes featuring Anime Flux's work (not including slide-ins, cut outs, and promotional material). As well 12+ Chibi H scenes. We want to make sure its well worth the 15$ price tag when we finally get it to release.

[*]Demon's Will still having amazing music and sound direction. We have quite the sizable OST ready for you guys...  in fact, we are so confident in it that we will be releasing the OST a week out from the final release date. We'll post up a new sample for you guys to hear real soon.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and you can except us to to keep you guys updated consistently from now on thanks to us getting our shit together. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/criticalbliss/what-my-neighbors-are-demons-an-adult-visual-novel/posts/2553246]For more in-depth information please visit our Kickstarter page[/url]. Now that we finally got things back on track we will be heading towards making a new demo to show all this new talent and updates that we have done over the past year. Even with our rocky development the team has improved in skill and we want to give you a taste of what we have in store. 

In the meantime we be slowly re branding  and changing out the art that we have displayed on the store page to better reflect how our game is gonna look. You'll see goodies and even H scenes pop up real soon!

notes.title: What!? WMNAD Is Getting an Update!!?
notes.content:
That's right boys and girls and all manner of demonic ilk. Here's the first development update we have for you and it's got some good and bad news in it. Things like that usually come in pairs, just like Cevi and Vulse our adorable demon siblings.

The good news is that we have made huge headway since the WMNAD's demo and have overhauled most of everything starting with the UI, through the art style, visual and sound effects, and even the funky music we know a lot of you love so much. Suffice to say, we have been working extra hard in order to bring you the best possible experience when the game finally releases.

This is sadly where the bad news kicks in. While the amount of work we put into the game has been moving us forward at a steady pace, the title is not yet ready for prime time and we will need a few more months to make it meet our standards of quality.

This is why we are forced to move the release date to sometime in the [b]second quarter of 2018[/b]. While you wait for us to finally open the portal to the demonic world of depravity and lust, you can always follow us on Patreon to get quick and easy updates on the progress we are making into the final release.

Thank you for your continued support and interest. Stay lewd!
